abilities.name: Deadly Footing
abilities.text: The area of the venom pool is difficult terrain, and each creature moving through it takes 10 acid damage for every square of its area that it moves into.

abilities.effect: The pool produces a 9th-level *cloudkill* (DC 40) at its center. It then rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Poison Puff
abilities.trigger: A creature moves through any square in the hazard's space

hazard.description: A shallow, foul-smelling puddle of toxic acid blocks a narrow hall, and poison bursts from it when disturbed.
hazard.disable: DC 40 Crafting (master) or DC 42 Survival (legendary) to neutralize the acid while within reach of it. Three successes using either skill (or a combination of both) destroys the hazard.
hazard.name: Venom Pool
hazard.reset: The hazard ends after 1 minute, contracting to its original size and keeping still until disturbed again.
hazard.routine: (2 actions) The hazard uses its first action to spread 10 feet down the hallway in both directions. Once out of the hall, each side spreads in a random direction each round, but they don't go through doors. The hazard uses its second action to move the center of the *cloudkill* up to 20 feet in any direction to which any part of the pool has line of effect (normally, to encompass the greatest number of characters). If the *cloudkill* isn't present, it instead uses its second action to produce a new cloudkill, as Poison Puff.

hazard.stealth: +30 (legendary) to distinguish between the hazard and the oozes within it; DC 0 to notice the pool

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
